__readme: Planned renames for the evaluator-vocabulary program, read by index.mjs. `scope` decides what a match may be: `identifier` matches a bare identifier outside comments and strings; `subpath` matches an import specifier; `flag` matches a CLI flag token; `wire-field` matches an object KEY only, and only inside the files its `paths` names. Wire fields are path-restricted on purpose: `checks` and `repetitions` are ordinary English elsewhere in this repo, and a rename proposed against prose is a rename nobody can review. The configured count is deliberately absent: `repetitions` stays the canonical per-case count and `--repetitions` the canonical flag, with `--iterations` its deprecated alias (settled 2026-09-08, #4774). `iteration` names one execution instance only, so no rename may map the count onto `iterations`, and `--max-trials` is out of scope.
